map.由各分量不确定度与自由度求有效自由度: Find the effective degrees of freedom from component uncertainties and their degrees of freedom
map.输入两组分量不确定度 u、v 及自由度 ν，求有效自由度。: Enter the uncertainties u, v of two components and their degrees of freedom ν to get the effective degrees of freedom.
map.📖 查看「由各分量不确定度与自由度求有效自由度 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the effective degrees of freedom from component uncertainties and their degrees of freedom"
map.用于查 t 表确定包含因子。: It is used with a t table to set the coverage factor.
map.📚 深度解析：韦尔奇有效自由度: 📚 Deep Dive: Welch effective degrees of freedom
map.t 分布选 k: Choose k from the t distribution
map.nu_eff = u_c^4 / sum(u_i^4/nu_i)。例：u1=1,: nu_eff = u_c^4 / sum(u_i^4/nu_i). Example: u1=1, nu1=10; u2=2, nu2=5 gives nu_eff about 9.1.
map.ν_eff=(2.5²+1.5²)²/(2.5⁴/6+1.5⁴/12)=(8.5: ν_eff = (2.5^2 + 1.5^2)^2 / (2.5^4/6 + 1.5^4/12) = (8.5)^2/(6.5104 + 0.4219) = 10.42. The combined degrees of freedom fall between those of the two components, leaning toward the one with the larger uncertainty.
map.据 nu_eff 查 t 表定包含因子 k，而非固定取 2。: Use nu_eff to look up the coverage factor k in the t table rather than always fixing k=2.
map.先合成 u_c，再算 nu_eff。: First combine to get u_c, then compute nu_eff.
